waitlist.doneDescription: We'll email you the moment DormCheck reaches your school.
waitlist.headingGeneric: DormCheck isn't live at your school yet
waitlist.description: We're live at {{schools}}, and expanding campus by campus. Leave your email and we'll tell you when it's your turn.
waitlist.alreadyLiveDescription: Good news: DormCheck is already live at your school. No waitlist needed, just sign in with your school email.
waitlist.coldStartDescription: Enter your school email to see where your campus ranks on the waitlist, and how to move it up. We only use it to find your school; you are not signing up for anything yet.
waitlist.signedUpLine_one: 1 student has signed up so far. Here is how to move {{schoolName}} up the list:
waitlist.signedUpLine_other: {{count}} students have signed up so far. Here is how to move {{schoolName}} up the list:
waitlist.noOneJoinedDescription: No one from {{schoolName}} is on the waitlist yet. Join now and get your campus on the board.
waitlist.failedLoadingDescription: We could not load the live standings right now. You can still join, share the link, and loop in your school below.
waitlist.notOnListYetPrompt: Not on the list yet? Add your school email:
waitlist.alreadyOnListToast: You were already on the list.
waitlist.copyFailedToast: Copy failed. Select the link and copy it manually.
waitlist.adminNameEmailRequiredToast: Please add the contact's name and email.
waitlist.step1Description: The more students at {{schoolName}} who sign up, the sooner we launch there. Send this link to your group chats:
waitlist.step2Title: Get your housing office or university admin on board
waitlist.step2Description: When your housing office or university admin backs DormCheck, {{schoolName}} jumps the line and the partnership conversation starts directly. Add a contact and we will draft the email for you. It opens in your mail app, from you, with the DormCheck team cc'd.
waitlist.emailDraftHelperText: Opens your mail app with an editable draft. DormCheck is cc'd so the team can follow up on the partnership.
